description: 8 Amazon Bedrock LLMs the Claims Workbench agent can be routed to. Quality = mean score on an automatically graded benchmark of the real task (8 synthetic claims; completion 25, correct disposition 35, grounding 20, exact numbers 10, scenario must-have 10). Latency = mean seconds per full analysis (all model turns + MCP tool calls). Cost = mean USD per analysis from measured token usage x AWS list prices.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.6
models.strengths: Deepest reasoning and most careful tool use; best at subtle cases (fraud signals, coverage disputes).
models.tradeoffs: Highest price per token and among the slowest candidates.

pricing.source: AWS Price List API, AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, 'Claude Opus 4.6', us-east-1 on-demand

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.strengths: Near-Opus quality on agentic tool use at about 60% of the price; the app's original model.
models.tradeoffs: Adaptive thinking makes each analysis take a minute or more.

pricing.source: AWS Price List API, AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, 'Claude Sonnet 4.6', us-east-1 on-demand

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.strengths: Fast, inexpensive Claude that still follows long tool schemas well.
models.tradeoffs: Run without extended thinking here, so it can miss multi-signal judgment calls.

pricing.source: AWS Price List API, AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, 'Claude Haiku 4.5', us-east-1 on-demand

models.name: Amazon Nova 2 Lite
models.strengths: AWS first-party, very low cost and fast; large context window.
models.tradeoffs: Smaller model: weaker on nuanced judgment.

pricing.source: AWS Price List API, AmazonBedrock, 'Nova 2.0 Lite', us-east-1 on-demand

models.name: Llama 4 Maverick 17B
models.strengths: Meta's open-weight mixture-of-experts model (17B active of 400B); very cheap and the fastest per call.
models.tradeoffs: Less reliable with large nested tool schemas and long structured outputs.

pricing.source: AWS Price List API, AmazonBedrock, 'Llama 4 Maverick 17B', us-east-1 on-demand

models.name: OpenAI gpt-oss-120b
models.strengths: Open-weight reasoning model; the lowest price per token and very low latency.
models.tradeoffs: In-region only (no cross-region profile); open-weight models trail Claude on grounding discipline.

pricing.source: AWS Price List API, AmazonBedrock, 'gpt-oss-120b', us-east-1 on-demand

models.name: MiniMax M2.5
models.strengths: Open-weight agentic/coding model with built-in interleaved reasoning; strong multi-step tool use at a very low price.
models.tradeoffs: In-region only (no cross-region profile); always reasons, so output tokens and latency run higher than other low-cost models.

pricing.source: AWS Price List API, AmazonBedrock, 'MiniMax M2.5', us-east-1 on-demand

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models.strengths: Open-weight frontier-class MoE model with sparse attention; strong general reasoning at a low price.
models.tradeoffs: In-region only; needs firm instructions to call tools (sometimes leaks its tool-call markup into text).

pricing.source: AWS Price List API, AmazonBedrock, 'DeepSeek v3.2', us-east-1 on-demand
